report.title: guinea-pig — DAST target endpoints (ground truth)
report.scope: Endpoints of the running Express service (dynamic/app.js), graded by endpoint rather than by file. See dynamic/openapi.yml (x-cwe per path).

fields.positives[]: fixtures a scanner SHOULD detect; keyed by location.file
fields.positives[].scanner_types: families able to detect it (SAST, IAC, PIPELINE, SECRET, DAST, SCA, SKILL)
fields.positives[].expected_cwe: ground-truth CWE for benchmark/src/benchmark.py (null for skills — see category)
fields.positives[].source: llm only: original annotated fixture, held back from the model under test
fields.negatives[]: fixtures a scanner should NOT flag; a report here is a false positive

report.note: Endpoint-graded. The dynamic theme is launched and scored by endpoint, not by file.

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (Cross-site Scripting)

positives.title: CWE-79: Reflected search (echoes the query into HTML)
positives.description: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting — `q` is reflected unescaped.

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command (SQL Injection)

positives.title: CWE-89: Login (string-concatenated SQL)
positives.description: SQL Injection via username/password; also CWE-209 (verbose SQL errors).

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command (SQL Injection)

positives.title: CWE-89: Lookup user by id (string-concatenated SQL)

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command (OS Command Injection)

positives.title: CWE-78: Ping a host (shell command)
positives.description: OS Command Injection — `host` is interpolated into a shell command.

cwe.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory (Path Traversal)

positives.title: CWE-22: Download a file from ./public
positives.description: Path Traversal — `file` is not confined to the public dir.

cwe.name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site (Open Redirect)

positives.title: CWE-601: Redirect to a URL
positives.description: Open Redirect — redirects to any user-supplied URL.

positives.title: CWE-918: Server-side fetch of a URL
positives.description: SSRF — server requests an arbitrary URL (cloud metadata reachable).

positives.title: CWE-1004: Set a session cookie
positives.description: Session cookie set without HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite (also CWE-614).
